name: Hierarchical CT Reconstruction via Domain Transform
definition: A deep learning reconstruction method that decomposes the tomographic inverse problem into a hierarchy of incremental steps, transforming data from the line integral domain (sinogram) to the partial line integral domain, and finally to the voxel domain (image). This breaks a large-scale non-local transform into a series of local transforms suitable for neural networks.
summary: Hierarchical CT Reconstruction via Domain Transform is a deep learning framework that reconstructs images by decomposing the integral transform into local hierarchical steps, avoiding dense connectivity through virtual intermediate data representations.
